key_highlights: ASX slumped as miners and banks fell; oil price spike fuelled inflation and rate-hike fears, sending bond yields higher
Fourth RBA rate hike looms amid home-grown inflation; mortgage stress at 18-year highs
Australia narrowly avoided recession but per-capita GDP contraction and 'bad to worse' productivity signal structural weakness
Coal boom provides a partial offset for energy names; gold discoveries (Gateway, King River, Auric) support junior miners
Housing market under severe stress: 10% price decline forecast, mega-developer Bathla near collapse, Evergrande-style contagion risk
Mineral Resources ASIC investigation concluded with no action for Ellison — positive for MRL sentiment
Qantas ground crews vote for strike right amid pay dispute — operational risk for QAN.AX
USD slips on dovish Bessent comments; AUD/USD likely supported but offset by domestic rate-hike pressure

sectors.trend: Mixed: major miners (BHP, RIO, FMG) under pressure from ASX-wide sell-off and oil-driven inflation fears, but coal boom and a wave of gold discoveries (Gateway Wiluna, King River 44g/t, Auric $28M profit, PLC Murchison) provide junior-miner support. Lithium exploration (ZhongNuo/Chariot in Nigeria) signals continued commodity diversification.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners face near-term headwinds from rate-hike fears and potential demand slowdown; junior gold and coal names offer relative strength. Monitor iron ore and thermal coal prices closely.

sectors.trend: Banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) fell with the ASX as rate-hike fears and mortgage stress at 18-year highs raise credit-loss concerns. CBA fee controversy adds reputational risk. Bond yield spike compresses net interest margin expectations.
sectors.implications: NIM expansion from a fourth hike is offset by rising provisioning risk. Housing downturn (10% price drop forecast) threatens mortgage book quality. Defensive but not immune.

sectors.trend: Oil price jump is a tailwind for Woodside (WDS.AX) and Santos (STO.AX). Coal boom benefits Whitehaven (WHV.AX) and others. Chinese solar overtaking coal is a medium-term structural headwind for thermal coal.
sectors.implications: Short-term oil/coal price strength supports energy names; long-term energy transition narrative (China solar) caps upside for coal majors.

sectors.trend: Severely negative. Housing 'bloodbath' forecast, Bathla developer near collapse, mortgage stress at 18-year highs, per-capita recession fears. REITs face rising borrowing costs and falling occupier confidence.
sectors.implications: Avoid property-linked REITs and developers short-term. Consumer staples (WES, WOW) may see defensive rotation but face margin pressure from inflation.

sectors.trend: Canva (CVA.AX) faces employee-privacy legal dispute. Iran conflict 'bombs AI bubble' globally, pressuring tech sentiment. Nvidia earnings beat-and-raise supports global tech but AI-bubble concerns persist. CSL (CSL.AX) relatively insulated.
sectors.implications: Global AI volatility spills into ASX tech. CSL remains a defensive anchor. Canva legal risk is a minor overhang.

sectors.trend: Qantas (QAN.AX) ground-crew strike vote introduces operational disruption risk. Denny's rival Chapter 11 filing signals global consumer-dining stress.
sectors.implications: QAN faces near-term operational and reputational risk; monitor industrial action escalation.

key_themes: Rate-hike cycle: fourth RBA hike imminent, bond yields spiking, mortgage stress at 18-year highs
Housing correction: 10% price decline forecast, developer insolvencies (Bathla), Evergrande-style contagion
Commodity divergence: coal/oil boom vs. iron ore/soft-commodity weakness
Productivity crisis: 'bad to worse' performance, bureaucratic drag, per-capita recession
Geopolitical risk: Iran conflict, Venezuela instability, global AI-bubble concerns
Gold exploration wave: multiple WA/Qld discoveries supporting junior miners
Mineral Resources ASIC clearance removes overhang for MRL.AX

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike and rising bond yields
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour floating-rate and short-duration credit; hedge with gold and energy

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and developer insolvency contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid property REITs and construction names; monitor Bathla and other distressed developers for systemic spillover

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (Iran, Venezuela) disrupting oil and risk appetite
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain energy hedges; keep cash allocation elevated; monitor AUD/USD for safe-haven flows

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Qantas industrial action disrupting aviation operations
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce QAN.AX exposure pending resolution; monitor for broader transport-sector contagion

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Productivity stagnation and per-capita recession eroding corporate earnings
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour companies with pricing power and export revenue; avoid domestic-demand-dependent names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mortgage stress and credit losses hitting bank provisioning
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor NPL trends at CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC; favour banks with stronger capital buffers

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight coal and oil-exposed energy names on commodity price strength
opportunities.rationale: Coal boom and oil spike provide near-term earnings tailwind; Chinese solar transition is a medium-term, not immediate, risk

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to gold juniors on WA/Qld discovery wave
opportunities.rationale: Gateway Wiluna, King River 44g/t, Auric $28M profit, PLC Murchison extension signal a gold exploration upcycle; gold as inflation hedge
ASIC investigation concluded with no action for Ellison; removes overhang on MRL.AX valuation

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to CSL and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Per-capita recession and rate-hike environment favour defensive, pricing-power names

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or avoid property REITs and construction/developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house-price decline forecast, Bathla insolvency risk, 18-year-high mortgage stress create severe downside

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim large-cap bank exposure pending credit-loss data
defensive_moves.rationale: Mortgage stress and housing correction elevate provisioning risk; NIM gains may be insufficient offset

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Qantas exposure pending industrial action resolution
defensive_moves.rationale: Ground-crew strike vote introduces operational disruption and reputational risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain 10-15% cash or short-duration bond allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Elevated geopolitical risk (Iran, Venezuela), rate-hike uncertainty, and housing contagion warrant liquidity buffer

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to remain under pressure from rate-hike fears, oil-driven inflation, and housing-sector stress. Miners and banks lead declines. Gold juniors and coal/oil names offer relative outperformance. Qantas strike risk adds volatility. Expect ^AXJO to test lower supports.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Coal/oil transition and gold exploration wave support commodity names. Productivity and per-capita GDP concerns cap broad-market upside. Housing correction, if it materialises, will be a 12-18-month drag on financials and construction. CSL and export-oriented miners remain structural winners.
